reddit.title: Improving Colony Music Experience in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to the music in Provincia! The day, night, title, and combat beds now feature a smooth transition instead of abrupt cuts. This means a more immersive experience as the music flows seamlessly. Check out the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops

steam.title: New Music Enhancements in Provincia
steam.body: We're thrilled to announce that we've implemented a new audio system for Provincia! The transitions between different music beds—day, night, title, and combat—are now smoother than ever, thanks to a new crossfade technique. This enhancement will create a more immersive experience as you build and manage your colony. For more details, visit: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
